name: Paddy Doctor: A Visual Image Dataset for Automated Paddy Disease Classification
description: Paddy Doctor is an extensive, peer-reviewed visual benchmark dataset comprising 10,407 labeled RGB photographs of paddy crops (Oryza sativa) collected from agricultural regions in Tamil Nadu, India. The dataset classifies individual paddy plant leaves across ten distinct categories: nine devastating plant pathologies (bacterial leaf blight, bacterial leaf streak, bacterial panicle blight, blast, brown spot, dead heart, downy mildew, hispa, and tungro) and healthy control plants. Captured under varied natural illumination and growth conditions, Paddy Doctor serves as the official benchmark for the ACM IKDD CODS-COMAD 2023 competition and ongoing Kaggle challenges, advancing low-cost disease monitoring for smallholder farmers.
